macro_full_jump_fibre_shell_bounds.source_scope: Exact whole jumping three-beam Fourier source, arbitrary coefficients and EVERY fixed flat holonomy, in the frozen free-reference momentum fibre. Other coordinates sum by Parseval; all125 photon branches may be arbitrary coherent normalized coefficients.
macro_full_jump_fibre_shell_bounds.proof: E>=.12 forces some |sin p_j|>=.05; E<=.30 gives B<=exp(.30), cos p_j>=2-exp(.30). Exact dE/dp_j=sin(p_j)(B-cosh(E)+cos(p_j))/(B sinh(E)) gives the displayed positive velocity. Each discrete +/- branch has at most eta L/(pi v)+2 points. Literal Wilson DFT coefficients at the strong coordinate cost<=4/(L² margin²); 3 coherent beams and3 possible strong coordinates give72. No smooth density and no continuum replacement of the lattice count.
macro_full_jump_fibre_shell_bounds.not_irreducible_floor: The +2 is a uniform discrete fibre count, not an irreducible full-source phase floor. Actual thermal/toron joint averaging can further sharpen it.
macro_full_jump_fibre_shell_bounds.joint_toron_contract: This fibre bound alone does NOT prove the spectral strip of the original theta-dependent body/toro heat/source operator. Its noncommuting toron energy/source correlations must be bounded or evaluated; no heat/source commutation is asserted.
